laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Soos as' is spoken and clumsy in written text; 'soos wanneer' is the natural written form with the same meaning.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Unchanged sentence that sets the safety condition; 'soos as' is accepted Afrikaans, so the swap is lateral, consistent with the first round.

laat_vaar.blok: Ook vir iemand wat jy ken
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A list of three verbs reads more smoothly with a comma than with a repeated 'en'; the meaning is unchanged.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The repeated 'en' is a deliberate emphasis on each of the three relationships and is correct; a restyle only, consistent with the first round.

laat_vaar.blok: By die kliniek en die dokter
laat_vaar.voor: vra dan jou en die grootmens by jou
laat_vaar.na: vra dan vir jou en vir die grootmens by jou
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: With two people as the object of 'vra', 'vir' before each is the natural Afrikaans construction and avoids the stiff 'vra dan jou'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'vra jou en die grootmens' is correct, natural standard Afrikaans; adding 'vir' twice lengthens the consent sentence without fixing anything.

laat_vaar.voor: Sê dit vir nog een as daardie grootmens nie help nie
laat_vaar.na: Sê dit vir nog 'n grootmens as die eerste een nie help nie
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Naming the noun first makes it clear at once that 'nog een' means another adult; the condition is unchanged.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: In context 'nog een' plainly means another adult, so the original is clear; rewording a who-to-tell safety instruction with no fault to fix is not justified.

laat_vaar.blok: As niemand naby jou help nie
laat_vaar.voor: Jy bel 116 enige tyd van die dag of die nag.
laat_vaar.na: Jy kan 116 enige tyd van die dag of die nag bel.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The bare present 'Jy bel 116' reads like a report rather than telling the child it is possible; 'Jy kan ... bel' is the natural form and still says the child phones herself.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Turns the plain Childline instruction into a possibility; unchanged sentence, consistent with the first round.

laat_vaar.na: Vra daarom voordat jy aan hom raak.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Aanraak' needs an object; 'aan hom raak' points back to 'iemand anders' in the sentence before.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'aanraak' is accepted Afrikaans without an object, and 'aan hom' adds a gendered pronoun and narrows the rule; consistent with the first round.

vlae.teks: Medisyne is 'n middel wat help om siekte of pyn te behandel.
vlae.rede: The study sentence leaves out the second half of the decided shared definition of medisyne ('of om te keer dat 'n mens siek word'), which the lesson's own glossary entry has. Whether that is deliberate is a content question, not a language one, so this is not proposed as a change.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: en nie sommer aangeraak te word nie
laat_vaar_vorige.na: en om nie sommer aangeraak te word nie
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Repeating 'om' makes the two parts of the right parallel, so the second part clearly belongs to 'Jou reg'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The original glossary definition is grammatical, because one 'om' can govern both infinitives; adding a second is a lateral change to a definition that only the writer may reword.
